Name: 1oxnes and Talkohlooey's Artstyle Portrait - The Farmer's Children
Author: DreamWoIf
Description:
[size=3]Talkohlooey's portraits are by far my favorite, so I wanted to create one for one of my favorite immersive mods, The Farmer's Children.

[url=http://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5436]The Farmer's Children[/url] by xiddav
[url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/11904]﻿1oxnes and talkohlooeys' Seasonal Portraits[/url] for the best experience when used together

the big 3.0 update!

[b]Dynamic Adoption Token[/b]
➤ The game now dynamically detects whether the child is adopted or biological, adjusting portraits and sprites accordingly.

[b]Divorce Memory Fix[/b]
➤ Children now retain memory of their parent after a divorce—no more blank sprites or missing portraits.

[b]Custom Spouse Support[/b]
➤ Fully compatible with custom spouses! Children now recognize and display the correct portraits for non-vanilla spouses. [i](See Articles.)
[/i]
[b]Ridgeside Village & Stardew Valley Expanded Support[/b]
➤ Fully integrated with RSV and SVE spouses. [i](Download available under Optional Files.)[/i][/size]

If you find any bugs or loading issues, feel free to let me know!
